title: Clinical Coverage Policy — Qualification and Delivery of Mobility Equipment
content:
# Qualification and Delivery — Mobility Equipment

## 1. Qualifying a coverage-billed order

A coverage-billed Mobility Equipment order qualifies only when the patient:

1. meets the class's coverage criteria set;
2. weighs no more than the class's patient weight capacity;
3. had the face-to-face examination no more than the class's face-to-face lookback days before the order date, where that value is above 0;
4. has a specialty evaluation where the class requires one, with ATP involvement where the class requires it.

All four must hold. A written order older than the class's written order validity, in months, cannot be delivered.

## 2. Gates on delivering a power chair

**Home accessibility.** Where the class requires a home accessibility assessment, a power chair is delivered only after an in-home accessibility assessment on this wheelchair record shows the home accessible. The evidence is the system's assessment record on the same wheelchair record, read before the delivery.

**Prior authorization.** When the class falls under the power-mobility prior-authorization requirement and the primary coverage's class requires prior authorization for power mobility, a power chair is delivered only once a prior authorization request on this wheelchair record is approved and the delivery date is within the coverage's prior-authorization validity days of its decision date; a non-affirmed request may be corrected and resubmitted. The evidence is the system's request record on the same wheelchair record — its type, its status and its decision date — together with the class of the primary coverage, read before the delivery.

| Class falls under the requirement | Coverage class requires prior authorization for power mobility | Delivery of the power chair |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | only once an approved prior authorization request on this record exists and the delivery date is within the validity days of its decision date |

## 3. Delivery

Delivery follows within the class's delivery lead, in business days, in the home with training where the class requires in-home delivery with training.

## 4. The chair furnished

The chair furnished must meet its code (the class's HCPCS code): the frame weight band for a manual chair, and for a power base at least the minimum top speed and the minimum range on one charge, with a power seating option only where the class accepts one.

## Points of judgement

- **Whose word settles the home assessment and the authorization?** The system records on this wheelchair record; an assessment or a request on another record does not count.
- **Face-to-face lookback of 0.** The examination condition applies only where the class's lookback is above 0.
- **Hypothetical prior authorization timing.** A request approved with a decision date of 1 March under a coverage whose validity is 90 days (hypothetical figure) supports a delivery dated no later than 90 days after 1 March.
